name: Takamiya Subaru
source:
A Blade of the Crescent Moons, as well as Haruka’s close friend and senior kunoichi. During the effort to stop the Noroi Faction from traveling to the future, she lost to one
of their leaders, Ittou Hagane, after which she was imprisoned in Castle Infinity.
translation:
